planSummary: Typed boundary hardening wave for RuntimeSnapshotStore defaults and normalization while preserving ASK source-run CLI compatibility.

slices.title: 001 Snapshot Contract Coverage
slices.description: Add TypeScript contract coverage for current snapshot runtime artifacts without changing runtime behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Snapshot runtime contracts are exported from the TypeScript contract layer.
Contracts cover session, task board, task-indexed snapshots, projection state, replay proof, and runtime snapshot artifact grouping.
Fixture coverage compiles under `npm run typecheck`.
Existing current artifact contracts remain compatible.

slices.title: 002 Snapshot Defaults and Normalization Tests
slices.description: Add tests that lock current RuntimeSnapshotStore default and normalization behavior before refactoring.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover session fallback behavior.
Tests cover task-indexed snapshot fallback behavior for representative verification/workflow/freshness snapshots.
Tests cover projection state normalization for missing, invalid, and loose payloads.
Tests cover replay proof default/merge behavior.
Existing replay projection tests continue to pass.

slices.title: 003 TypeScript Snapshot Runtime Helpers
slices.description: Add typed helper functions for snapshot defaults and normalization while keeping source-run loading safe.
acceptanceCriteria: `ask-core/src/runtime/RuntimeSnapshotStoreRuntime.ts` exports typed default and normalization helpers.
Helper fixtures or contract tests compile under `npm run typecheck`.
Helper behavior matches the runtime default and normalization tests.
Source-run runtime files do not import `RuntimeSnapshotStoreRuntime.ts` directly.

slices.title: 004 Source Runtime Uses Snapshot Helper Seam
slices.description: Refactor RuntimeSnapshotStore.js to delegate defaults and normalization through a source-compatible helper mirror.
acceptanceCriteria: `RuntimeSnapshotStore.js` imports `RuntimeSnapshotStoreRuntime.js`, not `.ts`.
Public `RuntimeSnapshotStore` method names remain unchanged.
Snapshot fallback, projection state normalization, and replay proof merge behavior remain unchanged.
`AskPaths`, `FileStore`, and `RuntimeProjectionEngine` remain unchanged.
Existing projection and runtime snapshot tests pass.

slices.title: 005 Migration Status Update
slices.description: Update TypeScript migration status for the completed snapshot/runtime store boundary wave.
acceptanceCriteria: Docs mark snapshot/runtime store boundary hardening complete for this wave.
Docs state full source-only `.ts` runtime loading remains deferred until CLI build/shim strategy is selected.
Docs identify the next likely step as task/slice runtime conversion or CLI build/shim strategy.
Docs preserve contracts-first, runtime-conversion-later, strictness-last framing.
